request.region: If present exact positive integral admitted LogicalServerID; mismatch rejected. Not room override.

wire32783.np_info: JSON string with inactive title_info="@@@@", bubble_info="10001@0", canonical conquer_lev/conquer_loop_id; no acquired/equipped entitlement claim
wire32783.numbers: Exact finite integral AMF-safe values; IDspositive<=2^53-1. Canonical PlayerType retains no invented semantic range, but unrepresentable wire integers fail closed

transactions_and_effects.commit: One caller-owned tx commits once; semantic output private until DefiniteCommit. Any unknown/error aborts preparation/publication; no replay.

retry.reason: Fresh bounded authorization observation, no settlement or receipts. No retry around socket work.

transactions_and_effects.time: One fresh PostgreSQL clock_timestamp observation per bounded sender/recipient read. No NamedEpoch/quota policy is added; process monotonic clocks govern transport deadlines only.

authorization.ingress: Exact current incoming handle and supplied admitted actor/role/room/generation must agree; never substitute latest context handle
authorization.sender: Fresh canonical I4 actor and exact I6C admitted Guild binding in bounded callerTx; no raw bearer retained
authorization.recipient: Each exact snapshotted handle must retain admitted actor/role/room and Guild JOIN. Fresh current canonical validation in its own bounded callerTx; commit then registry-current recheck and existing handle gate before enqueue
authorization.revocation_boundary: Authorization is observed at DB snapshot/time, not held through I/O. Revocation/expiry after that read can race already admitted publication. Do not hold gameplay locks to claim instantaneous revocation. Retired handle rejects sends after retirement linearization.

room_policy.GUILD: RoomID=canonical GuildID and exact admitted JOIN event
room_policy.SERVICE: Room99999 among current admitted SERVICE handles across logical-server contexts in supported single realtime-owner deployment
room_policy.classification: Selected I4 room/role registry policy + explicit reconstruction scope, not historical deployment-shard truth

operational_policy.max_snapshot_handles: Existing RealtimePolicy.MaxConnections; default2048; overflow rejects whole publication before any enqueue, never silently truncate
operational_policy.concurrency: Nonblocking global message slots before any DB read; at most16x8 local workers waiting on global8 recipient slots. Snapshot<=16xMaxConnections handles. Parent cancellation stops new work; drain joins workers and releases slots.
operational_policy.full_budget: Recipient transaction/cleanup and wait inherit remaining publication deadline; completed commit then exact-handle recheck before queue admission.
operational_policy.rate: No durable/per-player10-second server quota. Existing finite frame/admission budgets plus these limits; source client10s pacing and debug/FreshManGuide bypass remain source observations.
operational_policy.wire_outcomes: No invented ACK/error packet. Invalid/auth/stale input closes; valid provider-gated type1..8 or operational saturation drops without push and keeps socket; sender prepare/infrastructure failure closes fail-closed; failed recipients skipped independently.
operational_policy.uncertainty: A Send error/caller deadline does not prove zero bytes or cancel admitted frames. Already admitted frames may complete later under existing writer timeout. No retry, rollback or client consumption claim.

delivery.history: Client-local only; no server replay/offline queue/outbox
delivery.self_echo: Only same32783 fanout; no separate successACK or duplicate local sender frame
delivery.partial_failure: No room-wide retry after any enqueue/write; no transaction rollback of transport
delivery.duplicates: Each nonce-less receive is a separate publication attempt; no parameter-hash dedupe/exactly-once claim
delivery.ordering: Existing per-socket writer enqueue order only. Concurrent room messages can be observed in different orders; no global room sequence
delivery.restart: Loses in-flight ephemeral work; stale/unqualified recovered Presence rows do not recreate handles or replay messages
